answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the onyx is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the saffron of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
